newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in thin trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in thin trade this morning with most traders away for the New Year holidays, dealers said on Monday.
"The market has been very quiet for the past one week. A lot of the traders are on leave since the Christmas holidays," a local dealer said.
He added that some traders are just watching the figures on the U.S. November existing home sales due to be released tonight but do not reckon it would have an impact on the market.
"Traders have generally squared off their books now for year-end and would only open new positions in the New Year," he said.
In short dates, Monday/Tuesday rose 4/16 percentage point to 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent from last Friday's 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent and week-fixed remained at Friday's 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent.

Among term rates, two-months, four-months eased 1/16 percentage point to a common 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent, nine-months remained at 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent and twelve-months also remain unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16 percent.
